newsitem.title: USA: Tanknology to sell tank testing business.
newsitem.headline: Tanknology to sell tank testing business.

text.p: Tanknology Environmental Inc said on Monday it reached an agreement with NDE Environmental Corp to sell its three subsidiaries involved in underground storage tank services.
The sale price consists of a cash payment of approximately $12 million to be paid at close of the transaction, expected to occur within the next two weeks.

NDE Environmental supplies specialized field and management services to storage tank owners and operators. Tanknology provides environmental products and services to owners and operators of under and aboveground storage tanks.
